summary: Forest Lookouts' only item for this Klamath County Buck Mountain is a 1912 plan for a telephone and lookout; no source confirms a build or its site today.

events.note: Newspaper report of a plan: a telephone to be established on Buck Mountain, which will be used for a lookout. Plan only; no build record in the sources read

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1912 newspaper calls the body the Klamath-Lake Counties Fire Protective Association; the archive's records for 1911-21 use Klamath-Lake Counties Forest Fire Association. The two appear to be the same association under slightly different names, so the record keeps the 1912 name.

notes_for_editor: Only one dated item (a May 1912 newspaper report of plans) and the archive's name history. No build date, design, status, staffing or later history was found in the sources read. The firelookout.com Oregon list has no Buck Mountain in Klamath County (its Buck Mountain is in Lane County, FFLOS US 942). The Forest Lookouts page gives the township as 39S-6E-19, which the story leaves out. A human should confirm the site exists and what stands there before the story is extended.
